meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,助手能按流程接入微信个人号渠道:启用微信渠道并引导扫码登录(腾讯官方 iLink 长轮询,无需 Webhook 和 API 密钥);登录后再把收到的微信会话绑定到智能体分组,机器人便能回复微信消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给机器人接入个人微信(如说“添加微信渠道”),或处于 /setup 要启用微信渠道时,会进入该技能流程。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接进来,让机器人能回复微信消息。
say.note: 会先检查环境并安装微信渠道。
会告诉你去日志或 qr.txt 里读取。

say.text: 微信已扫码,把新会话绑定到我的智能体。
say.note: 会运行 wire-dm.ts 完成绑定。

howto.what_en: The assistant can connect a personal WeChat channel: enables the adapter, guides QR login, wires incoming chats to an agent group, then the bot replies. Uses Tencent iLink long-polling; no webhook or API key.
howto.when_en: When you ask to connect your personal WeChat (e.g., “add the WeChat channel”) or choose to enable WeChat during /setup.

say_en.text: Set up my personal WeChat so the bot can reply to WeChat messages.
say_en.note: Runs the installation steps and asks you to scan the QR code.

say_en.text: How do I see the login QR code?
say_en.note: Tells you to check the logs or qr.txt.

say_en.text: WeChat is logged in; wire the new chats to my agent group.
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to complete the binding.
